# RFP answering engine

> A small engine that answers questions about a solicitation (RFP) and its amendments with the exact clauses it rests on, or refuses. Python 3.9+, standard library only. Runs locally as an MCP server for Claude Code or Claude Desktop.

Figures in an answer are quoted word for word from a cited clause or the summary is withheld. An amended value always wins over the base text. Drafting proposal language and bid/no-bid verdicts are refused in code. With no model available it fails closed: status "unavailable", relevant clauses, no answer. The documents in data/ are a short fictional RFP and one amendment written for this sample.

## Start here

- [README.md](README.md): what it does, trust rules, measured results, gaps
- [sample.json](sample.json): the same facts as structured data
- [altitude-components.html](altitude-components.html): the three reading depths and their construction rules (checked by tools/altitude_lint.py)
- [AGENTS.md](AGENTS.md): instructions for coding agents (shared base; Codex and Hermes read it)
- [CLAUDE.md](CLAUDE.md): Claude Code entry, imports AGENTS.md
- [agents/openai.md](agents/openai.md): OpenAI Agents SDK and Responses API
- [agents/hermes.md](agents/hermes.md): Hermes MCP config
- [mcp/README.md](mcp/README.md): install the MCP server and run the checks

## Code

- [source/rfp/parse.py](source/rfp/parse.py): splits documents into numbered clauses
- [source/rfp/resolve.py](source/rfp/resolve.py): decides which text governs after amendments
- [source/rfp/answer.py](source/rfp/answer.py): retrieval, model call, and every check
- [source/rfp/provenance.py](source/rfp/provenance.py): Merkle proofs for every cited clause, the amendment hash chain, and a receipt per answer (optional Ed25519 signing)
- [tools/verify_receipt.py](tools/verify_receipt.py): checks a saved answer's proofs and receipt
- [mcp/server.py](mcp/server.py): stdio MCP server with answer_question and list_questions

## Optional

- [data/rfp_sample.txt](data/rfp_sample.txt): the fictional RFP
- [data/rfp_sample_amendment_1.txt](data/rfp_sample_amendment_1.txt): its amendment
- [mcp/sample_golden.json](mcp/sample_golden.json): the 8 evaluation cases
